001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import dev.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
005import dev.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
006import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
007
008/**
009 * A base implementation of a node item backed by a Metaschema definition.
010 *
011 * @param <D>
012 *          the Java type of the definition
013 * @param <I>
014 *          the Java type of the instance
015 */
016public abstract class AbstractDefinitionNodeItem<D extends IDefinition, I extends INamedInstance>
017    extends AbstractNodeItem
018    implements IFeatureOrhpanedDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
019
020  @NonNull
021  private final D definition;
022
023  /**
024   * Construct a new node item for the provided definition.
025   *
026   * @param definition
027   *          the Metaschema definition this node represents
028   */
029  public AbstractDefinitionNodeItem(@NonNull D definition) {
030    this.definition = definition;
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  public D getDefinition() {
035    return definition;
036  }
037}
